messages:
ben: Quick sync — planning a fractional rollout for /v2/generate tomorrow Tue 2026-03-18 14:00 PT. Need deploy owner, smoke checks, rollback readiness, and cohort mapping. Proposed ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~90m. Who can own?
maya: I can own the deploy and initial smoke. Can do 14:00 PT. Will stand by in #eng-oncall for first 30m.
ashwin: I'll own the gradual ramp automation. Proposed schedule: 0–15m: 1% (smoke), 15–45m: 5%, 45–90m: 20%. Abort if error rate > 1.5% or p50 lat increases > 200ms.
olivia: Cohort mapping: start with internal + canary customers (user_ids in group "canary-pool"), then US-EAST, then EU-WEST. Exclude APAC for now.
ben: For rollback — please confirm the rollback command + who has privileges.
sre-bot: deploy-plan accepted. Auto-rollback hook enabled. Alerting thresholds set: errors>1.5% OR latency_p50 >200ms for service=redwood.inference.v2
maya: Rollback command (manual):
```
redwood deploy rollback --service v2-generate --to-revision r2026-03-10-07
```
Permissions: maya, ben, olivia, ashwin are allowed. If auto-rollback triggers, oncall will get page.
ashwin: I'll wire up the percent ramps in the traffic router. Will push a PR for the schedule now @maya to review.
maya: Reviewing PR now. Smoke tests I will run:
- basic generation end-to-end
- token-level cost check (<1.2x baseline)
- function-calls sanity
If all green, proceed with next ramp.
olivia: Data collection: enable debug logs for the canary cohort only (`log.level=debug cohort=canary-pool`) for 1 hour.
ben: OK — deploy owner: maya. Ramp owner: ashwin. Observability: olivia. Oncall: sam (cc @sam). Deploy start 2026-03-18 21:00 UTC (14:00 PT). Everyone confirm by EOD PST.
sam: Got it — I'll be on pager.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by maya for 2026-03-18T21:00:00Z -> job id: dj-2994012345. Will post status updates here.
maya: Confirmed, scheduling. Will post smoke results in thread.
ben: Thanks all. If no objections I'll mark this green in the release calendar.
